mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in UNRATE above 6% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns due to weakening labor market conditions and reduced growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not negative when UNRATE crosses above 6% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in GDPC1 above 10,000 and RSAFS above 500 million signals robust demand, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when both GDPC1 and RSAFS exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a monthly FEDFUNDS rise above 3% triggers negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns due to policy tightening.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not negative when FEDFUNDS crosses above 3% in a tightening regime.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly growth in INDPRO above 97.5 (2012 vintage) signals robust supply-side expansion, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not positive when INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS falling below 130,000 persons monthly triggers negative 5-day S&P 500 forward returns due to labor market weakening and reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns not negative when PAYEMS drops below 130,000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in GDPC1 above 14,000 and HOUST above 700 units signals robust household and business demand, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery regime, FEDFUNDS falling below 1% monthly signals accommodative policy, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not positive when FEDFUNDS drops below 1% in the specified regime.
